intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a school with a big list of all the rooms. Some rooms are empty — nobody has ever used them. One room has 1,244 letters in it — but they're letters the teachers wrote to each other, not students. And one room has 7,502 names on the wall, and nobody remembers who wrote them there. The first job is to find out.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like opening the pantry and reading every jar's label. Some jars are empty. One jar is full of letters the family wrote to each other. And one jar has 7,502 names in it, and the honest thing is to say: I don't know whose names those are yet — but I will find out before I claim anything about them.
